transformations.edit: Replaced the seed string recorder with an executable Verus function whose body is the Rust 1.96 target body `index.get(self)`, adapted only to the explicit receiver parameter `slice`.

Adapted the source `pub const fn` and `[const] SliceIndex<Self>` bound to a non-const Verus harness function over a target-local `SliceIndex<T: ?Sized>` trait with `Output: ?Sized`; no executable control-flow or data-flow step was changed.
Preserved the exact-vstd target contract as the public `ret == spec_slice_get(slice, index)` postcondition and retained the `axiom_slice_get_usize` in-bounds/out-of-bounds facts for `usize` indexing.

Introduced a trait-associated `spec_get` view so Verus can prove the direct `index.get(slice)` delegation without a cyclic self-reference between the local trait contract and `spec_slice_get`; added the minimal `usize` `SliceIndex<[T]>` implementation needed by `axiom_slice_get_usize`.
